resources.string: Soft flowing colors on the chat page. Off by default.
Require: ask before every tool. Assist: allow low-risk tools, ask for risky actions. Full: skip normal prompts. Applies only to this chat until the app closes. Android permissions remain separate.

The agent may read or change files, control apps and send network requests without normal tool prompts. Mistakes can expose data or cause loss. Only enable this for tasks and models you trust. Root commands and Android permission requests still need confirmation. You can switch back at any time.
I understand and accept this risk
Plan first; use /plan off to leave
Set a goal: /goal your task; /goal off clears it
Models come from your provider account. Choose a native live-audio model; connection confirms support. Custom gateways may require a model ID entered manually.
No native live-audio models were listed. Check the provider, API key and account access. Speech-to-text and TTS services are not live conversation models.
Choose a provider with an API key and a native live-audio model. This call uses model audio directly and does not use phone TTS.
This audio device is unavailable. Choose another output.

These extra rules apply in Assist mode. Low-risk tools may run automatically; risky actions still ask unless you explicitly allow them for the chat. Change blanket access in the conversation, not here.
